73.reasoning: A water image turns a figure upside down: what was at the top goes to the bottom, while left and right stay where they are. In the given figure the wavy line dips on the left and rises on the right, so in its water image it rises on the left and dips on the right. Figures (3) and (4) both show that, and they are drawn almost alike; NTA's final answer key gives Figure (3). Figure (1) is the original unchanged, and Figure (2) has a different wave.
